question: Operation Brahma was launched by India in March 2025 to provide relief to which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Myanmar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Brahma** was launched by India in **March 2025** to provide humanitarian relief to **Myanmar**, which was facing a severe crisis due to political instability and natural disasters.
 
• The operation aimed to deliver essential supplies such as **food, medicines, and shelter kits** to affected populations in Myanmar.
 
• India, being a neighboring country, has historically extended support to Myanmar during crises, emphasizing its commitment to regional solidarity and humanitarian assistance.
 
• The relief operation also involved coordination with **international organizations** such as the United Nations and local agencies in Myanmar to ensure efficient distribution of aid.
